We design and develop python applications such as Hammer which enables end-to-end changelist validation, Argus which monitors infrastructure health, Bee/Hive which intelligently reports build errors. Each major application also has a rich web front-end based on Django. As a PEY of the team, you get to work alongside our full-time engineers and architects to deliver high quality products to developers. You will: • Develop new features and enhance existing features for our suite of applications • Design and develop brand new applications that solve unique problems or provide new benefits to developers • Enhance and enrich our ever-growing portfolio of web front-end applications Work on infrastructure level changes such as adoption of brand-new library/framework/technology • As a DevOps engineer, you will also spend some time on daily operational tasks: • Help with monitoring daily builds, track and resolve build failures Help with answering developer tickets, regarding usage of our applications • Our compensation is designed to reflect the Canadian labour market. The actual salary offered may vary based on several factors, including the position's location, as well as the candidate's experience, skills, training, and job-specific knowledge. In addition to base salary, we offer performance-based incentive opportunities that reward both individual contributions and overall company success. Estimated Salary Range: $90,000 - $95,000 CAD We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess, or select applicants for the position. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Canadian work experience is not required for this role.
